name: User-supplied real natural scenes v1
limitations: Two user-supplied photographs and three scoped words; not a representative benchmark.
Latin and tiny or partially visible background text are excluded under the user-confirmed scoring policy. Training/test overlap is unknown.

samples.condition: Outdoor bilingual road sign with background clutter
samples.reviewer: User confirmed labels and scoring scope in chat on 2026-11-25; boxes manually proposed by assistant

samples.condition: Dense multilingual commercial signs and partially visible text
samples.reviewer: User confirmed labels and scoring scope in chat on 2026-11-25; boxes manually proposed by assistant

scoring_policy: Three user-confirmed readable words only. Predictions with at least 50% of their area within the declared evaluation region are scored. Latin and tiny/partial background text are excluded. This is a scoped pilot, not whole-image multilingual accuracy.
